verdict.rationale: Organizing requests into a hierarchy is a fair question for a feedback and roadmapping tool like Canny, so the axis applies. The pack does not show a features/components/initiatives hierarchy. The only nearby claim is the MCP page's generic "organize requests", which does not describe any hierarchical structure. Linking feedback to Jira, Linear and similar issue trackers is a sync feature, not request hierarchy, so it is not credited here.
